symbols.name: input bit length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each input.
symbols.quote: Let $n$ be the bit length of each input.

symbols.name: digit bit width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in one radix digit.
symbols.quote: Let $b$ be the number of bits in one radix digit, and let $q = \lceil n/b \rceil$ be the number of digits in each input.

symbols.name: digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of radix digits in each input, q = ceil(n/b).
symbols.quote: Let $b$ be the number of bits in one radix digit, and let $q = \lceil n/b \rceil$ be the number of digits in each input.

symbols.name: radix
symbols.meaning: The base 2^b in which each digit is written.
symbols.quote: The radix is $Q_0 = 2^b$, the base in which each digit is written.

symbols.name: product coefficient
symbols.meaning: The integer coefficient of Q_0^j in the product of the two digit polynomials.
symbols.quote: The integer coefficient $c_j$ is the coefficient of $Q_0^j$ in the product of the two digit polynomials.

symbols.name: position index
symbols.meaning: The index of a position in the coefficient list, counted from 0 upward.
symbols.quote: The index $j$ runs over the positions of the coefficient list, from $0$ upward.

symbols.name: carry
symbols.meaning: The amount carried into position j from the lower positions.
symbols.quote: The carry $k_j$ is the amount carried into position $j$ from the lower positions.

symbols.name: output digit
symbols.meaning: The j-th base-Q_0 digit of the output, with 0 <= d_j < Q_0.
symbols.quote: The digit $d_j$ is the $j$th base-$Q_0$ digit of the output, so $0 \le d_j < Q_0$.

relations.quote: Carry propagation takes its input from [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md): the output is the list of integer coefficients $c_0, c_1, \dots$ of the product of the two digit polynomials.
